name: tool_hunter
prompt: One production-ready static transparent PNG game asset for a medieval goblin side-scrolling mobile game. Same NON-PIXEL flat hand-painted cartoon art as the reference: irregular clean painted contours, broad matte muted ochre wood/gray iron/olive/brick-red patches, just two close-value shades per material, minimal volume. Strict side elevation, slight hand-drawn wonkiness, no top-down or isometric view. Large readable silhouette at 100 pixels high. Whole object framed with margin, all feet and support posts on one consistent ground baseline. No background, no cast shadow, no halo, no scenery, no characters, no text, letters, numbers, interface, glow or pixel blocks. Redesign the reference into a clearly distinct TALL goblin archery tool stall. A curved upright bow rack forms the silhouette, enormous bow-and-arrow emblem high above a small bench, bundled arrows and quivers, a round straw archery target at the side, olive green narrow canopy. All rack feet touch baseline. No mallets or armor.
review: accepted: bow-arrow crest, olive canvas, target and arrow bundles; non-pixel painted transparent static bitmap
